definition: The smallest particle of an element that can exist. Made up of a nucleus (protons and neutrons) surrounded by electrons.
clues: This is the basic building block of all matter
It contains a nucleus and electrons
It is the smallest part of an element
The smallest particle of an element — made of protons, neutrons and electrons

clues: This is a subatomic particle
It is found in the nucleus
It has a positive charge
A particle in the nucleus with a relative mass of 1 and a relative charge of +1

definition: A particle with no charge found in the nucleus of an atom. Relative mass: 1, relative charge: 0.

It has no electrical charge
A neutral particle in the nucleus with a relative mass of 1 — it does not affect the charge of an atom

It has a negative charge

clues: This is found at the centre of an atom
It is positively charged

The dense, positive centre of an atom — contains protons and neutrons and holds almost all the atom's mass

The total number of protons plus neutrons in the nucleus — tells you the approximate mass of the atom

Atoms of the same element with different mass numbers — same protons, different neutrons

clues: This is a key reference in chemistry

It has rows and columns with specific names
All elements arranged by atomic number — elements in the same column share similar chemical properties

clues: This is a feature of the periodic table
It is a horizontal row

clues: This is a feature of the periodic table

The halogens — they exist as diatomic molecules and reactivity decreases down the group

It has one outer electron
A soft, reactive metal from Group 1 — reacts with water to produce hydrogen and a hydroxide, reactivity increases down the group

definition: An element in Group 7 of the periodic table. Exist as diatomic molecules and react with metals to form salts.

A non-metal from Group 7 — forms diatomic molecules and becomes less reactive going down the group
